prompt: A code editor window set over the open sea of a nautical chart, seen from slightly above, the window drawn in crisp off-white line art with a title bar and three small dots, inside it a layout grid with column guides, dashed alignment guides crossing the window, small square handles at its corners and a few empty rectangles snapped to the grid.
